_comment: Isang Minutong Salita — daily 1-minute audio Bible verses or prayers in Tagalog. Add entries with an audio file URL in 'src' (mp3, ~1 minute; host in this repo e.g. ofw-companion/audio/, or any https URL). The newest entry with a src plays; with no playable entries the home card shows a warm 'malapit na' placeholder. No code changes needed.
